intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, and both are listed with GATE. This page compares recorded fees and ranks from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.
Jain University vs MSRIT should not be read from the ₹7,500 Jain row, which is a registration fee, not tuition. MSRIT also has a NIRF 2025 Engineering rank of 75 on this page.

sections.heading: Jain University vs MSRIT for M.Tech / M.E.: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose MSRIT if you want the recorded year total of ₹1,35,510 and the NIRF 2025 Engineering rank of 75, after you confirm the official fee notice.
Choose Jain University if you want one of the listed specialised M.Tech programmes at the recorded year tuition of ₹75,000, after you ignore the ₹7,500 registration fee as if it were the course cost.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Jain University we hold ₹75,000 as tuition for one year on several M.Tech rows, plus a ₹7,500 registration fee. Do not quote the registration amount as the programme fee.

For MSRIT we hold ₹1,35,510 as a Total Fees year figure across aerospace, AI, data science, biotechnology and other listed M.Tech programmes. That is a year amount, not a confirmed two-year official total.
Confirm the current notices on jainuniversity.ac.in and msrit.edu before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Jain University's only M.Tech placement row here is from 2019, with ₹4 lakh average and ₹5 lakh highest for Artificial Intelligence. That year is too old to treat as a current flagship figure.
MSRIT has no M.Tech placement row on this page. Ask both placement cells for a recent official report rather than using the 2019 Jain row.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both campuses are listed with GATE. Follow the official postgraduate admissions notes for any non-GATE route and counselling dates.
MSRIT has NIRF Engineering ranks of 75 in both 2025 and 2024 on our records. Jain University has no NIRF row on this M.Tech page.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Bangalore, Karnataka, so a local student can visit the labs on the same trip.
MSRIT is a long-running technical institute. Jain's listed M.Tech set includes aerospace, avionics and cyber security titles. Match the exact branch, not only the city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick MSRIT if the NIRF 2025 Engineering rank of 75 and the recorded year total of ₹1,35,510 fit your plan.
Pick Jain University if a listed specialised M.Tech and the recorded ₹75,000 year tuition are the priority, after official confirmation.
Do not decide on the ₹7,500 registration fee or the 2019 placement row.

faqs.question: Is Jain University's M.Tech fee only ₹7,500?
faqs.answer: No. The ₹7,500 row is a registration fee. Recorded tuition is ₹75,000 for one year. Use the official notice for the current total.

faqs.question: What M.Tech fee is on record for MSRIT?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹1,35,510 as a Total Fees year figure on several M.Tech programmes. That is not a confirmed two-year official total.

faqs.question: Are recent M.Tech placements available?
faqs.answer: No. Jain's only row here is from 2019. MSRIT has no M.Tech placement row on this page. Ask both campuses for a later official report.

faqs.question: What ranks are listed for MSRIT?
faqs.answer: Our records list NIRF Engineering ranks of 75 in 2025 and 2024 for MSRIT. Jain University has no NIRF row on this page.

faqs.question: Do both programmes use GATE?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both campuses are listed with GATE. Confirm any non-GATE route on the official admissions pages.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Bangalore, Karnataka.
